metadata.description: Agent skills for the Azure SQL Database container: the Azure SQL Database engine, running locally.

plugins.name: azure-sql-database-container
plugins.description: Seventeen skills that teach an AI coding agent to use the Azure SQL Database container correctly: start the engine, connect, migrate schemas, import data, scaffold apps, build local RAG, wire CI, run as a sidecar, go local-to-cloud, build no-code REST/GraphQL APIs with Data API Builder, build serverless and event-driven Azure Functions, seed realistic test data, integration-test with Testcontainers, add connection pooling and retry, connect securely with a least-privilege user and the right auth per environment, answer FAQs, and report issues.
